ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(Non_Compliant__c, ISPICKVAL(Lifecycle_Status__c, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Review_Outcome__c, "Not Reviewed"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Severity__c, "CRITICAL"), ISPICKVAL(Severity__c, "HIGH")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Critical and High non-compliant changes require an Authorised or Unauthorised decision.
